speaker: master_scribe
text: Traveler... At last.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: You have crossed the threshold and arrived in the Grey Commons. Every path in the Horizon begins here. The roads stretch in every direction. Some lead to prosperity. Some to purpose. Yet from where you stand, they all appear hidden by fog.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: This is the Scroll of Destiny. One day it will contain the story of your journey. But today - its pages are blank. As they should be.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Before the Scroll can guide you, you must first discover who you are. Beyond these fields stands the Mirror of Maia. Seek it. Learn what it reveals. Then return to me.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Mirror of Maia awaits, Traveler. Beyond these fields - seek it. Return when you have glimpsed your first sign.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Echoes grow bolder.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: They gather where purpose is unclear.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Stand with me, Traveler.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Drive them back.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Good. The Echoes have scattered.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: You have learned that some uncertainty must be faced directly.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Now return to the Mirror of Maia.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Your next sign is waiting.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Well done, Traveler.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: You drove back the Echoes of doubt.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: But there is one more you must face.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: This Echo is different.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Steel alone will not scatter it.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Force will not help you here.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: This Echo questions.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: It tests what you know - not how hard you can strike.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Approach it and press Enter.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Answer with what you have learned.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Echo glows nearby.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Find it when you are ready.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Well answered.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Not every Echo is defeated by force.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Some fade only when met with understanding.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Return to Maia, Traveler.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The next reflection awaits.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Every Traveler needs more than courage and reflection.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: They need records.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Tools.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Maps.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Memories.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Open the Scroll of Destiny.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Find what it remembers.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Good.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Scroll will remember what the mind forgets.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: One reflection remains.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Return to Maia and seek your Foretold Signposts.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
trigger: MQ-109 active or available, before Scroll reveal
text: The Scroll has awakened.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
trigger: MQ-109 active or available, before Scroll reveal
text: Wait...
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: This should not be here.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Your first signs are clear... but something else has marked the Scroll.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: I can record what the Scroll reveals. I cannot interpret what has awakened beneath it.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Oracle must see this. Find the shrine beyond the path, and return to me when her vision is complete.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Oracle Shrine lies beyond the Grey Commons.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Seek it.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Scroll has awakened - but only the Oracle can make its runes legible.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: You heard the Oracle.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Runes have settled - and they may now be read.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Three Foretold Signposts are sealed on your Scroll.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: They are not your destiny.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: They are not a verdict.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: They are the first roads asking to be examined.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: The Oracle also burned a mark into your Scroll.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: That mark is a link - a real-world research source about one of your signpost paths.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Open your Scroll of Destiny and look for the Oracle's brand.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Click it.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Read.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Take notes.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: That is your next task: not choosing a career, but learning how a Traveler studies a road before walking it.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: I have placed the Quest of Fate in your Field Journal.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Open the Scroll of Destiny, then Field Journal, then Work Files.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: Your document will be waiting there.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.

speaker: master_scribe
text: When your teacher creates your personal copy in Google Drive, you will find a link in Work Files as well.
voice_direction: Distinct elderly female Scribe: low contralto, weathered and gently scratchy, measured, warm, authoritative.
